_source: Static config for the Tender submission wizard. Form copy, field labels/sublabels and the success/pending modal copy are verbatim from decentraland/governance-ui src/intl/en.json (page.submit_tender.*, page.submit.*, modal.proposal_pending.*, error.tender.*). Field character limits come from src/types/proposals.ts newProposalTenderScheme.properties (project_name 1-80, summary/problem_statement/technical_specification/use_cases/deliverables 20-3500, target_release_quarter maxLength 7, linked_proposal_id 36-255). The VP gate (SUBMISSION_THRESHOLD_TENDER = 1000) is from src/constants/proposals.ts. The linkable Pitch list is NOT config — it is fetched LIVE from catalyrst-governance GET /proposals (filtered type==='pitch'); see loadPitches() in governance-submit-tender.ts. Submission is a SIMULATED Snapshot write (the DAO runs on Snapshot + Aragon externally, not a Catalyst service), so no pitches and no default_linked_proposal_id are hardcoded here.

page.title: Tender proposal
page.description: Tender proposals are the second step in the Bidding & Tendering process. The aim of this stage is to refine the problems outlined in the Pitch proposal, providing a clearer vision of what the execution teams should propose in their Bid proposals. This action requires at least 1000 VP.

summary.label: Summary
summary.sublabel: Provide a high-level overview of the idea behind this tender and its connection to the original Pitch proposal.

problem_statement.label: Problem statement
problem_statement.sublabel: Describe the specific problem that this solution aims to solve for the Decentraland community.

technical_specification.label: Technical specification
technical_specification.sublabel: Outline how the execution team could implement this solution. Please note that this is not binding, and execution teams may propose a new technical pathway in their bid proposals.

use_cases.label: Use cases
use_cases.sublabel: Explain how the target audience will benefit from this project, how they will use it, and the value they will derive from it.

deliverables.label: Deliverables
deliverables.sublabel: Detail all the artifacts that the execution teams should deliver as part of this Tender. For example, working software, documentation, marketing plans, social media strategies, etc.

target_release_quarter.label: Target release quarter
target_release_quarter.sublabel: State the anticipated release date for the community. Please note that this is not binding, and execution teams may propose a new date in their bid proposals.

coAuthors.label: Co-authors
coAuthors.help: If you co-authored this proposal with someone else, you can add their wallet addresses to acknowledge their work. After you publish the proposal, co-authors will be asked to confirm or reject the request. Only if they confirm, they will be listed publicly on the proposal page.

errors.linked_proposal_empty: Linked Pitch Proposal field is empty
errors.submission_vp_not_met: This action requires at least 1000 VP.

success.title: Proposal published
success.lead: Your proposal is now published. When the Tender submission period ends, it will be open for voting.
success.helper: Set a reminder in your Calendar for when the voting period begins.
success.note: This Tender was created in a simulation — no on-chain transaction or Snapshot proposal was submitted.

submit_error: There was an error while trying to create the proposal, please try again later.
